context:
Goal: every merge can be committed by some role, without losing test cases.
Problem (rule): no role can commit a merge whose conflicts touch both a test file and a product file. #1521 lets the test-author write the conflicted product files, which loosens a role guard on a coordinator ruling (2026-11-07 13:53 CST) with no word from you.
Based on (ruling): decision builders-cannot-edit-tests refuses a builder that keeps one side of a test conflict.
Based on (measured): #1521 round 3 (sonnet) PASS, net value zero. The same refusal hit #1871 at 06:51 CST Nov 8, and #1143, #1175, #1179 and #1166 on Nov 7.
Departs from: main, where a test-author writing any product file is refused — a test-author may write the product files git left conflicted, during a merge only.
Waiting on this: five PRs need #1521 to land their mixed-conflict merges: #1793, #1658, #1684, #1724 and #1490 (coordinator, 07:39 CST Nov 8).
Recommendation: b, because a widens a shared role guard; the coordinator leans a.
Meanwhile: runner 8 may batch #1521 under the zero-net-value rule; on b it comes back out.

options.gain: A mixed-conflict merge lands in one commit, and both sides' test cases are kept.
options.how: During a merge only, a test-author may write the product files that git left conflicted, and commit the merge.
options.label: Keep #1521
options.lose: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo. A test-author may edit conflicted product code during a merge.

options.gain: Role scopes stay as on main.
options.how: A builder aborts a mixed merge, and the lane splits it into a test-only merge and a code-only merge.
options.label: Split mixed merges
options.lose: Two merges and two review chains per mixed conflict, and some conflicts cannot split.

reply: You picked a (10:05 CST Nov 8), the widening option, over the recommended b. That goes against your ruling that a repo changes to fit a shared tool, and your pick overrides it for this case: #1521 stands, and the five waiting PRs can land. The lane records your ruling in its decision on #1521. Routed to the coordinator, runner 8 and lane mixed-merge-resolver; home: step mixed-merge-resolver. Closed 10:09 CST Nov 8.
short: Mixed merges: test-author may fix product conflicts
title: During a merge, may a test-author write the product files git left conflicted, so a mixed-conflict merge can land?
